analysis:
Examined four files; no concrete regression is supported by the visible evidence.

1. ScheduledWindowSelection.swift (head 12-29, 50-76, 81-113, 117-126): cached Autopilot builds now carry across scheduled windows. Trust is re-derived each window. The build is re-scanned through resolveModels and kept only if its fresh weightHash is in the set verified at start or by the previous window's provider (isVerifiedCached, line 73). A swapped or modified build (T-012, T-027) therefore drops out. The fingerprint is captured before scanning, which preserves the existing anti-TOCTOU ordering. The cached path is disabled for privateOnly coordinators and without consent (line 69). One cached model that vanishes or fails to scan is skipped via try? instead of failing the window (line 89). That is a fail-closed exclusion, not a fail-open. autopilotPendingCandidates is carried only with consent. The hash source ProviderLoop.autopilotCachedBuildHashes is not supplied, so its provenance is unverified.

2. StartCommand+Autopilot.swift (head 102-107): the inline eligibility checks are replaced by AutopilotBuildEligibility.allowsCachedBuild. The old checks were catalog active, minRamGb, ID length and non-empty, EngineV2 support, runtime capabilities and memory budget. The new implementation is not visible, so equivalence is unverified. The per-model verify call and the approved-set equality check are unchanged.

3. StartCommand+Modes.swift (head 210-235, 353-354, 489): with saved consent and not privateOnly, the start path loads a catalog-based AutopilotStartInventory, which is not visible. It adds cached builds as pending candidates to be verified after registration. Unverified builds should not be advertised before verification; that depends on the unseen AutopilotStartInventory.inventory(from:) and the pending-verification code. The fallback path keeps the old behaviour.

4. AutopilotStatusCommand.swift: adds read-only local display of the download settings and ledger usage. It is local-only, with no new network or secret exposure.

Open questions for integration: AutopilotBuildEligibility, AutopilotStartInventory, AutopilotDownloadLedger, the download code and ProviderLoop.autopilotCachedBuildHashes are all outside the supplied evidence. They need review for the following. Downloads must be verified against the catalog hash before a build is reported. The verified set must be reported accurately to the coordinator (T-027, TB-002). Disk, quota and consent gating must hold (T-016, A-004).
